examples.title: Tavo · 证据索引

examples.method: 以统一折角与等宽分隔定义文档单元，改变卡片宽高并保留附属引文方块。
examples.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one original minimalist modular identity study for the fictional AI research product Tavo, which gathers evidence into traceable answers.
